en: Swelling Forces
Eliminate $1oa Stormscale Myrmidons, $2oa Stormscale Sorceresses, and $3oa Stormscale Warriors for Arbal at the Grove of the Ancients.

Steel yourself for your time in the ruins, young one... you will not be granted free passage there.

Scores of cursed Highborne, now known as naga, roam the once great city. Travel northeast and dispatch them from this land.

What they once were... is no more. If they aid the Twilight's Hammer, they can bring only further pain to the forests that once gave them shelter.

War is what they seek, $c. War... is what we will bring.
Journey to Sentinel Hill
Report To Gryan Stoutmantle at Sentinel Hill in Westfall.

If you'd like to get started doing some good in our world, I'd recommend reporting to a man named Gryan Stoutmantle in Westfall to the south, at the settlement known as Sentinel Hill. His people are in need of aid.

After journeying here from another plane of existence, the problems our lands face may seem small. I assure you, the aid you provide to those impacted by such problems means everything to them, and you will grow stronger for your labors.

Good luck out there, adventurer!

I've been begging Stormwind for aid for months and he sends me a skinny elf? Well, beggars can't be choosers I suppose.

Welcome to Westfall, $c. Let's see if we can't put you to work.
Journey to the Crossroads
Report To Thork at The Crossroads in The Barrens.

After journeying here from the elemental plane, the problems our lands face may seem small. Rest assured, the dangers the horde faces are very real, and you will grow formidable should you survive your service.

If you'd like to get started doing some good in our world, travel southwest to the vast lands known as the Barrens. There is a settlement there known as the Crossroads. The proud citizens there are ever in need of aid.

Go with honor, adventurer!

What's this? An elf? And you say the Warchief sent you?

<Thork grunts sharply as he looks you up and down.>

You look a little skinny to me, but it matters not. Out here you'll either thrive and survive, or you'll die. That is the way of things in these lands.
WANTED: Jai'vhanel

Find and slay the owl known as Jai'vhanel and take one of her feathers. The black owl was last seen north of the Ameth'Aran ruins near the mountain base. Report the death of Jai'vhanel to Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea in Auberdine.

Attention!

A reward is being offered for the death of the owl "Jai'vhanel" also known as "Swordfeather".

Unfortunately this owl has gone mad and has begun to attack travelers as they journey along the road near Auberdine.

Jai'vhanel was last seen north of the Ameth'Aran ruins near the mountain base. Bring back one of her jet black feathers as proof of her death.

Reward claims for this bounty should be claimed with Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea in Auberdine.

The Auberdine Village Council
Greetings $c - what may the Sentinels assist you with today? Perhaps you are here to inquire about the bounty on Jai'vhanel?

It is good to know that issue has been taken care of, but it saddens me that we could not find another way. Jai'vhanel had been somewhat of a guardian of this area for quite some time, and I am not sure what could have caused her decent into madness.

Regardless, thank you for your service today, $c. The roads to Auberdine are safe for travel once again.
Gleaming Crescent Necklace
Deliver the Crescent Necklace to Maliynn in Astranaar.

<The silver necklace in your hands gleams gently as you examine it. The small crescent moon shape seems similar to other night elf symbols you've seen before.

Upon flipping the necklace over there is a small inscription: "Alor'lormah, Maliynn". Perhaps it belongs to Maliynn in Astranaar?>
Baron Marinous
Bring the Clouded Water Globe to Onu at the Grove of the Ancients in Darkshore.

All that remains of the powerful elemental is a globe of what seems to be pure water, clouded by some unknown substance. The edges of the sphere seem to be clear until you turn it--as if the cloud actively prevents you from peering within.

Whatever happened to it--and to the ruins it was guarding--is still active in some way.

Only Onu, the Ancient of Lore at the Grove of the Ancients to the far south, would have a chance at knowing more.
It's All Fun and Games Until...
Obtain a Peerless Eye from a Twilight Disciple or Thug at the Master's Glaive in Darkshore and find someone in Auberdine who is willing to take it.

<As you tear away the single page from the Twilight Tome, a foreboding voice floods your mind, uninvited.>

They have failed.

You will be forgotten.

They will lose the eye they gained.
Crown of the Earth
Bring the Drained Vessel to Lariia in the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.

<Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm's gaze narrows.>

You're still here?

Take the phial and get out of my sight, $c. It is clear my answers do not lie in the waters, just as they did not before. 

Perhaps one of the priestesses in the Temple of the Moon to the south will dispose of it.

<Fandral looks away, no longer speaking to you.>

I must look elsewhere if this is to work...
How may I aid you?

Do not mind the Arch Druid, $N. He bears the weight of much in Malfurion's absence.

Wait! Some drops yet remain in the phial! Perhaps that is why his incantation failed?
Hillsbrad's Hoard
Place the Sealed Company Request you were given on the bookkeeping table within Hillsbrad's town hall.

Hillsbrad's council hasn't answered our new magistrate's letters. The last word I pried out of a passing merchant from the town did little to justify their silence.

We're only asking for a small platoon--yet I'm told multiple siege ballista rest in pristine condition within a walled-off compound.

Walk into their town hall like a citizen returning a census request, and place this neatly upon the bookkeeping table.

Return to me when the deed is done.
Crown of the Earth
Bring the Moonwell Remnants to Tyrande Whisperwind in the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.

You must bring this to Tyrande at once! I will transfer it to a more ceremonial container for you.

Do not be afraid. The High Priestess of Elune is firm, but kind. She protects all who enter Darnassus, and carries our goddess' light to all.

She will be glad to receive this sacred water. You will find her directly above us.
Please state your business. I have a city to run, and a people to lead.

Staghelm has done much in my beloved's absence, but he is not Malfurion. And he does not run the affairs of Darnassus--that burden is mine alone.

<Tyrande's face settles.>

I apologize. As you have likely seen, we have many challenges to overcome.

Fandral is Arch Druid for now, and I ask you respect his station. But his doings pertain to druidism, and mine not only to Elune but indeed to lead our people as she wills.

Every drop of this water is blessed by our goddess. I thank you for saving it.
Eyes of the Sentinels
Place Sentinel Owls at the entrance to the Cenarion Hold depths, the Darnassus Bank, the Craftsman's Terrace Inn, and the City Gate for Sentinel Dalia Sunblade in the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.

General Feathermoon ensures all sentinels have time to pray to Elune. A proper huntress wields not blade alone, but gifts of the goddess to overcome our enemies.

You may help with my daily duties. Place sentinels around the city--start with the tunnels leading beneath Cenarion Hold to the north, the bank at the center of town, the inn in the Craftsman's Terrace to the northeast, and the city gates. The guards can assist you.

Something is amiss in Teldrassil--we must remain vigilant.
I thank you for your aid. Though I find peace in the daily rituals, it is nice to have a moment to reflect instead.
Stolen Freewind Supplies
Bring 8 Stolen Freewind Supplies to Jandia in Freewind Post.

Those wretched harpies! They attacked the last caravan I had scheduled to deliver supplies to Freewind Post. We have enough supplies for the moment, but without more supplies, we'll run short soon.

I'm not sure what the harpies plan to do with the extra supplies, but I would be grateful if you would recover them for me. They make their lair west of here. They can be found both at the base of the cliffside and inside a cave at the top.
Stop the Screeching
Slay $1oa Screeching Harpies, $2oa Screeching Roguefeather Harpies and $3oa Screeching Windcaller Harpies.

The Screeching Canyon is home to a local band of harpies known for their ferocious nature and raiding tactics. They have ambushed the last few supply caravans that have been brave enough to traverse this place.

I fear if something isn't done soon, there will be no caravans that will dare make the trek to Freewind Post.

Go, slay as many of these harpies as you are able. Return to me once the deed has been done, and I will reward you well for your efforts.
Brewer's Trade
Deliver the bottles of Fallrook Varietal to Dun Garok in southeast Hillsbrad Foothills, and bring back a sack of their Homebrew Hops.

Worked a bit o' a trade with the Dun Garok brew-kin. We're not the only ones missin' the vineyards of the Fallrook family, it seems! Most o' the best bottled years are long since drank, but we do have cases of the wine still in the cellars. 

Bring this case of Fallrook Varietal to Dun Garok in the southeast and leave it with 'em by their gatherin' fireplace at the bottom of their fort.

In return, carry a sack o' the Homebrew Hops back with ye.

That keep is the closest thing to home around here!
Crocs of the Sky
Collect 8 Pristine Crimson Scales and bring them to James Halloran in Menethil Harbor.

You're quite the go-getter! I have just one more favor to ask, if you're up for something a bit more dangerous.

The crocolisk trade is steady money, but they're small fish compared to what whelp scales will bring. Folks will pay top dollar for a sack of those.

Crocs of the sky, I call 'em! There's no way my apprentice could get them--but it seems right up your alley!

You'll find whelps far to the east, along the Green Belt. But be careful, there's nasty orcs in those hills!
Field to Clear
Sulhasa in southern Barrens wants you to clear out $1oa Stormhide lizards and $2oa Hecklefang Stalkers in the area so she can leave the tree safely.

I'm so glad you saw me!

The weather was lovely this morning, so I walked from Camp Taurajo down the golden road. When it came time to head back, I couldn't--a pack of hyenas started circling, and Stormhide lizards blocked my only escape.

Scrambling up this tree I went, and now there are too many foes about at this hour for me to make the run home through the fields.

Would you mind clearing out these Stormhide and Hecklefang Stalkers for me?
Scout Support
High Executor Darthalia wants you to deliver updated orders to Deathstalker Masoj, south of Tarren Mill, outside of Dun Garok.

Now that we can trust you to deliver critical information to our forward spies, there's an extra task for you.

Bring this to Deathstalker Masoj almost directly south of us. He'll have more for you to do once you get there and hand this to him. He is posted on elevated terrain north of the rotten vineyard they call Nethander Stead.

Our plan to take control of these lands continues steadily.
Valuable Vantages
Deathstalker Masoj needs you to place the three Apothecary Vials on peaks around Hillsbrad Foothills and return to him.

Our high command inserts strategic troops using bat riders. Key points around the foothills have lost their signaling beacons.

Take these vials. Uncork them in three locations: the hills bordering Dun Garok, the plateau overlooking Dunholde Keep, and the last on the ridge of the Headland above the town of Hillsbrad. The vapors that emanate will be like a potent tuning rod to the senses of the bat, drawing them to the desired drop-off points once more.

Look for crushed empty vials and renew our marks.
Pristine Pesterhide Pelts
Bring $1oa Pristine Pesterhide Pelts to Kristy Grant.

The Pesterhide hyenas of Thousand Needles have the most gorgeous coats. I haven't seen such a brilliant hue of fur like that in all of my travels!

I would like to send back some pelts to my sisters back in Stormwind, as I know they could make something incredible out of them.

I don't have any fighting experience, so I would be very grateful if you could gather some of the Pesterhide pelts in my stead.
Packaged Pristine Pelts
Bring the Package of Pristine Pelts to Kimberly Grant.

$n, you have been so helpful to me I hate to ask for yet another favor. It will be some time until I am able to return home to Stormwind. I was wondering if you would mind delivering these pelts to my sisters in my stead?

I am sure you are more likely to return there before I am able to. Please deliver these pelts to my sisters Kelly and Kimberly in Stormwind. They can usually be found in the Park.
Return the Statuette
Bring the Menethil Statuette to Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Keep.

My goodness, it's--it's beautiful!

The Blind Princess was to deliver this to Menethil Harbor before tragedy struck. We were so close!

I believe it was to be signed for by Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Keep just behind us. Why don't you do the honors of finishing the job?
A Friend of the Family
Bring the Menethil Statuette to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon in Stormwind Keep.

You'll want to take this to Stormwind right away. Proud as I am that this keep and harbor bears King Terenas Menethil II's name, we are a calm harbor in a very nasty storm of enemies. It's just not safe here.

The Dragonmaw in particular would sacrifice much to loot something like this... and I shudder to think of what they'd do with it.

Don't bother going up the chain of command on this one, $Glad:lass;. Go straight to Highlord Fordragon with this. He'll know where it will be best kept.
A Friend of the Family
Bring the Menethil Statuette to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in the Cathedral of Light.

King Terenas was a good man. A devout man. Beloved by his people, and truly the reason we have this Alliance at all.

The irony is he was humble--he hated these sorts of memorials, and so precious few exist. And of those, few survived Lordaeron's fall.

It seems the Light has coalesced in this statuette. It would be best kept in the Cathedral of the Light in Cathedral Square, in the center of the city. Bring it to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker for safekeeping.
Spoils of War
Recover $1oa Khaz Modan Timber and $2oa Khaz Modan Iron from Menethil Harbor for Valstag Ironjaw.

This harbor was first built by the Old Horde as a staging ground for their naval invasion of Hillsbrad. Completely circumvented Lordaeron's defenses!

So many lives lost...

What's worse is that fleet was built with the very resources they stole from Khaz Modan!

Plenty of it remains in the harbor after Admiral Proudmoore routed the brutes and built this place for the Alliance. We'll need it to bolster the town's defenses with the Dragonmaw on the move.
Bloom of the Heavens
Recover Nord'el for Sylessa Duskwhisper in Menethil Harbor.

I came to Menethil Harbor from Auberdine, from the great tree Teldrassil, to recover a bloom of great import to my people.

My people's ship the Flying Osprey crashed here many moons ago, joined with the Kul Tiran Third Fleet. Among its cargo was the flower known as Nord'el--Bloom of the Heavens in your tongue--bloomed under a full moon at the peak of Mount Hyjal, our former home.

Please help me retrieve it! The wreckage is just south of the city, but it is inhabited by fierce murloc raiders!
Bloom of the Heavens

Bring Nord'el to Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine in Darkshore.

You recall Sylessa mentioning a boat in Menethil Harbor can take you there.

Would you please deliver Nord'el to elder Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine?

The boat from here should be able to get you there swiftly.

I apologize for the request, I truly do. I remain fatigued from my journey here--and from fleeing those murloc devils when I first attempted to retrieve the sacred bloom!
Understanding Our Present
Use the Goaz Stone near the Goaz Warder and bring its Titanic Keystone back to Prospector Whelgar.

Old Gods?! This cannot be good news at all!

I've made out a new bit on the stone that speaks of a guardian of some kind. Whatever it is, it must be linked to the stone!

Take it with you and see if you can find a big Titan construct of some sort in the excavation. Read this here final passage on the stone and see what happens!

If I'm right, you'll activate the thing. Take it out if so, but try to preserve anything interesting! We simply must know more!
The Shamed Lieutenant
Speak to Lieutenant Farren Orinelle in Southshore in Hillsbrad Foothills.

Thank you again for delivering the statuette safely, $n.

I could use your help with something else. There's a member of the city guard who was reassigned to duty in Southshore out in the Hillsbrad Foothills.

His father was a friend of mine, and while I don't disagree that he could use the lesson... I'd still like to see him succeed. He would really benefit from someone like you helping him out.

There is a boat that can take you that way from Menethil Harbor, if you are passing back through.
From the Ashes
Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Keep wants you to destroy the 4 sets of Attack Plans in the Angerfang Encampment.

In the Second War the Dragonmaw built a fleet where we now stand, intending to take Hillsbrad. They nearly succeeded!

They were routed by the red dragons, left to mere stragglers deep in the mountains. However, there has been a surge in activity in their encampment northeast of Menethil.

Dun Algaz is proof that they intend to march to war once again and retake this land. Find their attack plans, take note of any critical information, and destroy them. We need to know where they will strike next!
Old Habits
Bring the Tattered Spellbook to Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Harbor.

This book has been badly burned--perhaps by the dragonfire that destroyed much of the Dragonmaw clan.

Of what little is legible, it seems to describe rituals relating to the use of the Demon Soul that the clan had used to control the dragons.

It is far too incomplete to be of real use, but based on roughly inserted pages on animal hide it seems Nek'rosh had attempted to salvage it. Freshly dried ink mentions a "Shadow Council."

Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Harbor would want to know about this.
This Land Was Their Land
Find Howin Kindfeather east of Menethil Harbor, along the road.

After the War of the Three Hammers that tore dwarven life as we knew it apart, the Wildhammers settled here, founding the mountain fortress of Grim Batol.

It was a wondrous place. Gryphons soared everywhere you looked, diving down through the wetlands to grab a fish.

It didn't last long, sadly.

Howin Kindfeather is one of the first Wildhammers to return in ages. Keeps to himself, far outside of town. Follow the road east--you'll find him eventually. He could surely use a hand.
Crimson Crate Delivery
Bring the Crimson Crate to Howin Kindfeather off the road to the east of Menethil Harbor.

Word is officially out on those whelps, $n. We already have an order in!

I'll package 'em up all nice for you, then you take it out to the customer. I know, I know; it's just one last favor, I promise!

These will be for one "Howin Kindfeather". Sent his gryphon into town of all things with a letter for the order! Says he's just off the road to the east, a bit past Whelgar's Excavation Site, if you're familiar.
Razormaw Needling
Collect $1oa Razormaw Incisors for Howin Kindfeather.

I don't know who I hate more: the bloody Dark Irons, the Dragonmaw, or the drakes they rode.

<Howin spits.>

I aim tae make things right. But we're gonna need some supplies.

These whelp scales will protect against dragonfire a good bit, but they're a pain in the arse tae weave together.

The Razormaw raptors up in Raptor Ridge to the northeast and Saltspray Glen to the northwest are so named for their pointy chompers--they oughta break through the scales.

Bring me a handful of the incisors.
Trying Times
Gather $1oa Perfect Razormaw Eggs for Howin Kindfeather.

I'll need some eggs if my plan is going tae work. Bassbeak needs a nice an' full belly--I ain't in the business of hoppin' on the back of a surly gryphon.

They need to be perfect--no cracks or anything.

Take some from the Razormaw raptors--they're known for having yolks the size of a gnome's noggin. You can find 'em in Raptor Ridge to the northeast and Saltspray Glen to the northwest.

Let's make it a nice even dozen, just to be safe.
Shipping Label
Deliver the Shipping Label to someone at the Azeroth Commerce Authority trade hub in Redridge Mountains.

<A torn shipping label can be found on the side of the now fully stocked crate. Though the intended recipient is torn off, details of its origin still remain.

"Property of the Azeroth Commerce Authority. Please return empty crates or unfulfilled shipments to our local trade hub at the Three Corners crossroads in Redridge Mountains. Couriers will be compensated for their time and travel."

Beside the text is a crudely drawn map of the area near the aforementioned destination.>
Ah, greetings! How can I be of assistance?

You have arrived at the right place! I am happy to mark you down as one of our affiliates. No contracts to sign and no commitments to weigh you down. All we ask of you is your diligence to assist in completing or returning any of our deliveries you find on your travels.

When you do so, you will be compensated with Merchant's Favor that will allow you to purchase goods and services we offer here. In fact, here's a little bit to get you started.

Now, do you happen to have the crate this came from?
Shipping Label
Deliver the Shipping Label to someone at the Durotar Supply and Logistics trade hub near the Crossroads in the Barrens.

<A torn shipping label can be found on the side of the now fully stocked crate. Though the intended recipient is torn off, details of its origin still remain.

"Return damaged shipments or empty crates to the Durotar Supply and Logistics trade outpost, now conveniently located due west of the Crossroads in the Barrens. Your time is valuable and we will compensate you for your efforts!"

Beside the text is a crudely drawn map of the area near the aforementioned destination.>
Good day, traveler. How can I assist?

You found the right place, and you're speaking with the right person! I can jot you down as one of our new associates. No paperwork necessary on your part, I can't be bothered with more of that.

All we ask of you is to assist in dealing with compromised deliveries you find during your travels. Doing so will earn you Merchant's Favor, which you can use to purchase goods and services right here. Here's a bit to get you settled in!

Do you happen to have the crate this label came with?
Never Coming Back
Kill $1oa Shadowhorn Stag and $2oa Ashenvale Bear and return to Va'xug Firefure northwest of Fallen Sky Lake.

Gaaah!

I'm so angry. They said Ashenvale was easy to follow. Easy for who? The beasts? The birds?

One moment I was gathering an herb, the next I'm trapped in this ravine. Do I truly have to circle half the forest to reach where I stood just moments ago?

When I'm like this, my spells grow volatile and behave... differently.

Could you thin the wildlife nearby? Even their stupid hooves grate on me. I despise this cursed forest.
A Void Path
Show Va'xug's Eye of Kilrogg the way back to the main Ashenvale road.

Show my Eye of Kilrogg the way out of this ravine and back to the Ashenvale road. Keep it moving and I'll follow once I see a clear path.

I'll stay here--one of us should keep our bearings. If you lose the way, I can guide you back through the eye. I will not have us both wandering blind in this malicious forest.

I can hold the channel for four minutes. No longer. Reach the road before the vision breaks, or return to me and we try again.
Alchemical Hazards
Collect an Unruptured Stalker Gland from Thelgen Rock for Caitlin Grassman in Menethil Harbor.

Certain alchemical recipes require ingredients sourced from, well, very dangerous places. And those are often just the base herbs! The other ingredients are even worse!

I need to make more antivenom before I can leave again. I swear everything in this marsh is venomous. It's like it runs through the land itself!

Can you help me? I'll need a venom gland from the spiders in Thelgen Rock to the far southeast. But it has to be unruptured, or too much venom will spill out before you can get here. Sorry!
Carnage
Bring Carnage's Head to Rethiel the Greenwarden in The Green Belt.

The natural order of this land is breaking. Once it was that the Razormaw raptors kept the land from overgrowth. They now live in fear of their alpha, named only for the carnage it leaves behind.

I fear the beast has been driven mad by the sickness that we have yet to fully excise.

It will respond to the malignant flesh of the diseased bears below Raptor Ridge, to the northeast. Leave their entrails in its cave lair.

Carnage will come. Bring me its head.
Camping 101: Enchanting
Speak with Nasalanna Windsinger in Shen'dar Village to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

Enchanters make everything better and are always welcome at any camp out in the wilds.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Enchanted Lute for your camp. It's so important to find entertainment during your downtime, and this bit of magic can help ensure you are ready to weather all sorts of challenges when you hit the old dusty trail once again.
Camping 101: Engineering
Speak with the Strange Hermit in Shadowgale Forest to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

An engineer is ever-resourceful, and if you are in the wilds alone, it's always good to be able to put your trade to use. No good camp is complete without a few helpful constructs!

Yes, come back and see me when you've gained a little bit of experience as an engineer and I can show you how to make something special!
Camping 101: Enchanting
Speak with Nasalanna Windsinger in Shen'dar Village to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

Enchanters make everything better and are always welcome at any camp out in the wilds.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Enchanted Lute for your camp. It's so important to find entertainment during your downtime, and this bit of magic can help ensure you are ready to weather all sorts of challenges when you hit the old dusty trail once again.
Camping 101: Engineering
Speak with Sprite Jumpsprocket in Stormwind to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

Engineers like yourself can cook up all sorts of bits, bots, and bombs for fun and profit.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Reagent Bot for your camp. This helpful automaton can help keep you well-supplied so that you and your allies never run out of the materials needed to fuel your spells.
Death to the Dragonmaw
Kill $1oa Dragonmaw Reclaimers, $2oa Dragonmaw Soulbinders, and $3oa Dragonmaw Infiltrators in Dragonmaw Retreat for Howin Kindfeather.

I plan tae get back into Grim Batol and reclaim it for the Wildhammers, $n. Or at least learn a thing or two.

Don't look at me like that, now. I know the risks. I don't intend tae go in hammer swingin', ye know.

Regardless, I'll need your help first. The Dragonmaw orcs march as we speak. They're all up an' down the Dragonmaw Retreat, where the red dragons routed them before.

I need you tae thin their numbers before I have any chance of gettin' close. Ye can't miss 'em if you follow the road east.
Forced Disarmament
Collect $1oa Dragonmaw Armaments in Dragonmaw Retreat, then bring them to Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Keep.

The Dragonmaw are stockpiling all manner of weaponry. It would be wise to relieve them of these before more soldiers can be armed.

Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Keep would surely be interested in these.
Stopping the Cycle
Kill the Subdued Dragonspawn at the Dragonmaw Gates for Howin Kindfeather.

I did a quick test flight while ye were out. The good news is the armor ye helped me craft for Bassbeak works like a charm!

The very bad news is I saw a group o' them Dragonmaw in the process of enslavin' a red dragonspawn.

Absolutely not. Not again.

You have tae take it out. You'll certainly need friends tae do so. Kill the warlocks holding it down first--that ought tae free it. Then put it out of its misery.

None of them will stand in the way of the Wildhammer.
Arugal's Folly
Bring $1oa Worgen Bits to Dalar Dawnweaver in The Sepulcher.

Ah, it's all become so embarrassingly clear! Arugal hardly had any magic at all, let alone enough to create the worgen. 'Arugal's Curse.' Pah! Barely potent enough to last a few seconds.

These shackles prove he can bind the beasts, not create them. The worgen clearly spread their curse a different way. I would know how.

Go to the Greymane Wall to the south. The worgen seem to be spreading to the humans nearby. Tear the beasts apart and bring me whatever you find. This requires a more direct approach.
Fangs, claws, gizzards. It makes no difference to me. The easiest way to study something is to see the guts yourself.

It appears I get the last laugh after all, haha! Arugal truly was a fool. And I, Dalar Dawnweaver, have exposed him as the fraud he is.

These pieces are all the proof I need that the curse has nothing to do with that blithering dolt.

Regrettably, that means his remedy is also worth nothing. It seems the search for a solution to the worgen curse continues.
Stop the Spread
Slay $1oa Sickly Refugees and $2oa Haggard Refugees for Dalar Dawnweaver in The Sepulcher.

If there is one thing we do know, it is that Arugal is responsible for worgen within Silverpine--be it his own machinations or otherwise. What we don't know is how it spreads.

While I research a way to stop the curse, our first priority is to contain it. It appears this affliction cannot infect forsaken, but a large group of humans have gathered by the Greymane Wall.

Go to the wall and put down these refugees before they have a chance to become servants for Arugal. And try not to get bit, $r.

It seems the Gilneans are not too keen on allowing anyone past their wall. That is fortunate, I suppose. It means there is likely no chance for the worgen curse to spread to their city.

Can you imagine the depravity if an entire kingdom were infected?
Word to Ironforge
Deliver Howin's Missive to King Magni Bronzebeard in Ironforge.

My work here is far from over, $n. And I need tae send word to me wife Claira in Aerie Peak--and get Falstad an update as well.

But that's my business. Wildhammer business.

That said, you ought tae let King Magni Bronzebeard in Ironforge know about all this as well. Wetlands is but a stone's throw from his lands, and none of what's happenin' here is good news on one's doorstep. This letter oughta do the trick.

Ye can travel back through Dun Algaz or fly from Menethil Harbor to get to Ironforge.
Gleaning Our Future
Use the Goaz Stone near Ados, Modr, Golm, and Neru and bring their hearts back to Prospector Whelgar.

There are other, larger golems all around the Wetlands. They each bear inscriptions marking them as Ados, Modr, Golm, and Neru--matching the missing pieces of the Goaz Stone you found!

I'd be willing to bet if we can bring pieces of them as well, we'll reveal more of the Goaz Stone!

You'll find Ados at the Dragonmaw Gates to the east, near Grim Batol. Modr is right outside Dun Modr to the north. Golm lies beneath Grim Batol, east of Dun Algaz. Neru's behind Direforge Hill, to the northeast.
For Further Study
Bring the Whelgar Relic Package to Historian Karnik in Ironforge.

Whatever this is all about, $n, it's epic stuff alright.

I'll bundle everything up nice for you. Take it to Historian Karnik in the Hall of Explorers in Ironforge. You'll usually find him in the back, nose-deep in some tome or another in the library.

It'll take a downright army to crack the case on this one, but if what we've seen so far is any indication it will well be worth it!
Secure the Mountain
Find Mountaineer Cornelius in the Grizzled Den for Mountaineer Gretchen.

It's bad enough havin' a troll problem, but the mountains are filled tae the brim with wendigos! They normally keep to their own caves, but they seem tae be spreadin' like bunnies. Now they've filled the Grizzled Den north of here.

If we want Whitebeard's report, we're gonna need to find my partner Cornelius. The blockhead got a little too excited and charged in head first. Brave, but stupid.

Head into the cave and see where he is. And feel free to take out some of the beasts while yer at it.

Ach, the fool...

Thank ye for the help, $N. Guess we have our report.
Flintfire's Shipment
Collect $1oa Flintfire Shipments from the Grizzled Den for Tongus Flintfire in Kharanos.

Hoha! Good to see a $r who's not afraid to get their hands dirty.

If yer lookin' fer work, I'm afraid I'm a little short on supplies at the moment. Our most reliable source of ore has been overrun by wendigo and now the cave has been abandoned. The miners had to drop everything when they fled!

Say, why don't ye poke yer head around the Grizzled Den to the west and see if you can find some of our missing shipments. It would save us a great deal o' trouble.
Wendigos are nasty beasties. Its just good all the miners made it out of the Grizzled Den in one piece!
Now that's more like it! With these shipments we'll get the forge back up and runnin' in no time!
Secure the Mountain
Check in on Mountaineer Gretchen west of Kharanos.

Spelunking dark caves is adventurer business. My job's just to make reports and send them over to Ironforge.

Trouble is, one of my reports hasn't... well, reported back. I asked a few mountaineers to learn more about the wendigo problem we have out here, but I haven't heard from them.

If you're already going to be out and about, what say you don't check in with Mountaineer Gretchen just west of town. I'm late enough as it is!

Ol' Whitebeard sent ya, aye?

I got his report, alright. This whole situation's a mess!
Secure the Mountain
Deliver Mountaineer Gretchen's Report back to Senir Whitebeard in Kharanos.

Hopefully ye put down a fair number of the mongrels while you were in there. Shame about Cornelius, though.

From what you described, there's not much to report other than the cave is a lost cause. Whitebeard's not gonna like that answer, but I'm not darin' sendin' anybody else into that death trap.

Feel free tae pass along the message, $n. I'm not leavin' this spot till the mountain's secure.

Ah, you're back just in time.

What's the matter, lad? You look like you've seen a ghost.

Completely overrun? Why am I not surprised.

Well, that's going in the report too.

<Senir folds Gretchen's letter into his pile of notes>
Frosthowl
Slay Frosthowl and collect the Sack of Fish for Gretta Ganter in Brewnall Village.

Do ye know how hard it is to fish on a frozen lake? My poor husband, Paxton, has been out in the middle of it for days and we barely have a single sack to show fer it.

Well, we DID have a sack to show fer it. Until the thrice-damned wendigo attacked me and made off with our haul. It'll take us weeks to fish all that back up! If that loudmouth Frosthowl didn't scare 'em all off, anyway.

Do us a favor and get it back, aye? Drooling brute is hiding somewhere deep in the Grizzled Den to the southeast.
It'll be a hot day in Dun Morogh before I tell Paxton I lost his entire stockpile to a wendigo.

Yer a real lifesaver, $N!

My husband would just laugh it off, but I couldn't bare tellin' him he has to spend another night on the lake. Maybe now we can enjoy a real feast.
The Great Cat Spirit
Speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade.

It would seem that you are ready for the next step in your journey, young druid. Dendrite Starblaze has sent for you, and wishes for you to seek him out in Moonglade once again.

You have already learned to call upon the magic to take you to Moonglade, so you should be able to embark immediately if you choose. I would suggest you leave soon, if you wish to continue your druidic training.
The Great Windborne Cat Spirit
Seek out the Avatar of Saeyleenan in the southern part Moonglade and learn what it has to share with you about the nature of the windborne cat.

A spirit of your homeland has recently appeared here and has asked me to guide you to it. This windborne cat spirit has come to tutor and mentor you so that you may take the feline shape of the spirit on Zephras.

All druids eventually seek this wisdom, though it seems your homeland has a slightly different shape than our traditional one. If you desire to take this spirit's feline form, you will need to undergo our trial.

It can be found in the southern part of Moonglade, south of the twin bridges.
The Great Cat Spirit
Recover the Relic of the Fang, Relic of the Claw, and Relic of the Silent Shadow from the Stormrage Barrow Den, and return them to the Great Cat Spirit.

To draw upon my spirit, you will need more than a few words. To understand and respect my form you must prove that you can embody cunning, stealth, and if you should be cornered, ferocity.

In the Barrow Dens just east of here, are three relics of my favor you must acquire. They are guarded by powerful enraged spirits that will attack you on sight. A statue at the entrance will bless you with temporary stealth to get past them.

Return these relics to me. We will see if you are ready to take my shape.
To Thunder Bluff
Return to Thunder Bluff and speak with Turak Runetotem on the Elder Rise.

The time has come for us to part ways once again, young one, as the application of your lessons takes you back to whom that sent you to me. It would seem your instructor, Turak Runetotem, has found a worthy pupil in you. I believe I see one as well. Heed his lessons and you shall soon be able to draw upon the Great Cat Spirit to take its shape.

Go back to whence you came. When the time is right, we will meet again.
An Unfortunate End

The deceased Night Watchman lying before you is covered in deep gashes and cuts. It's clear to see that he was mauled by some sort of large beast.

You notice that the corpse has an unlit torch in his hand. You reach down and pry it from his stiff fingers. This could be useful in your travels through Duskwood and beyond to reveal things hidden by darkness.
Alther's Mill
Slay $1oa Greater Tarantulas and destroy $2oa Tarantula Eggs in Alther's Mill for Foreman Oslow in Redridge.

Orcs, gnolls, murlocs. Everything seems to be out to stop me from getting this bridge done on time. Now we have word there's an infestation of tarantulas at our lumber mill!

If you're up to earn a bit more coin, would you head over to Alther's Mill to the east and clear out their spider problem? Place is as good as useless to me if I can't safely send workers to collect shipments.

Oh, and if you see ol' Alther, tell him he owes me for cleaning up his mess.

The mill is that bad? That's worse than I thought.

I'm not particularly squeamish, but work's bad enough without spiders snatching up my workers. Thanks for the help, $N!
Blackrock Blockade
Bring $1oa Stolen Weapons and $2oa Blackrock Supplies to Marshal Marris in Lakeshire.

You can't fight a war without weapons.

Though the Blackrock orcs have encroached upon these lands, their brazen efforts are not without certain vulnerabilities.

Head southeast below Stonewatch Keep, seek out their encampments, and target their weapons and supplies.

We'll see just how much of a threat they are without their tools of war.
Most of what you find will have been raided from Lakeshire anyway. It will do me good to know our people will thrive while the orcs wither.
A Light in the Darkness
Free $1oa Webbed Victims in Night's Web Hollow for Aramis Hammerhand in Deathknell.

Greetings, $c. Yes, I am a paladin. Not even death can stop the Light.

This is something my kind have in common with all Forsaken--we have overcome what the living view as their end. However, some even among our own fear us; they suspect we will smite them as some monstrosity.

In truth, our relationship with undeath is complex, but I am not here to hurt our own. Help me show the others this. Venture to Night's Web Hollow to the northwest and free the freshly raised fools trapped by the spiders there.

May this help Executor Arren and so many others see our true nature. Much like in our past lives, we live to serve our people--to protect them with the gifts the Light provides us.

They will see in time that we are just as valuable to the Dark Lady's plans as any other.

Light be with you.
The Sisterhood of Elune
Speak to Sister Aquinne in Darnassus.

Blessings to you, $c. The Sisterhood of Elune has stood as a pillar of kaldorei society for thousands of years.

Before the Great Sundering, before the War of the Ancients, through the Long Vigil, we have guided and healed our people through the darkness. Such is our charge, and such is the demand of the peerless Mother Moon.

We now require your aid in a matter of great importance. Sister Aquinne awaits your arrival in Darnassus.
I am glad you arrived so quickly. The Sisterhood requires your aid.
Darkness in the Glade
Collect Hatescreech's Amulet, Windmistress Gaedress' Amulet, and Witchmother Arysa's Amulet for Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak in the Oracle Glade.

These belts... look closely at the leather, $n. Do you see the taint running through the fibers?

I have a suspicion as to its origin, but we will need further proof to be sure.

Venture back out into the harpies' nests to the west and take out their leaders. If their necklaces carry the same darkness as these belts, we'll have our answer.
Have you wrested the amulets from the harpies' leaders?

<Arynia investigates the amulets.>

Do you see the foul green swirls within the gems? This is indeed fel moss corruption at work.

I have heard similar reports from Shadowglen and elsewhere in the boughs of this substance turning our very world against us.

I will inform my superiors of this at once.
The Great Cat Spirit
Speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade.

It would seem that you are ready for the next step in your journey, young druid. Dendrite Starblaze has sent for you, and wishes for you to seek him out in Moonglade once again.

You have already learned to call upon the magic to take you to Moonglade, so you should be able to embark immediately if you choose. I would suggest you leave soon, if you wish to continue your druidic training.
The Great Cat Spirit
Seek out the Great Cat Spirit in southern part Moonglade and learn what it has to share with you about the nature of the cat.

In the southern part of Moonglade, on a hill overlooking the bridge, resides a wise and cunning being we call the Great Cat Spirit.

Much like the Great Bear Spirit, this spirit has served as a tutor and mentor to druids that desire to take the feline shape. All druids eventually seek its wisdom, and if you desire to take the form of a cat, you will as well.

Go meet with the Great Cat Spirit and learn what it will teach you.
The Great Cat Spirit
Recover the Relic of the Fang, Relic of the Claw, and Relic of the Silent Shadow from the Stormrage Barrow Den, and return them to the Great Cat Spirit.

To draw upon my spirit, you will need more than a few words. To understand and respect my form you must prove that you can embody cunning, stealth, and if you should be cornered, ferocity.

In the Barrow Dens just east of here, are three relics of my favor you must acquire. They are guarded by powerful enraged spirits that will attack you on sight. A statue at the entrance will bless you with temporary stealth to get past them.

Return these relics to me. We will see if you are ready to take my shape.
To Darnassus
Return to Darnassus and speak with Mathrengyl Bearwalker in the Cenarion Enclave.

The time has come for us to part ways once again, young one, as the application of your lessons takes you back to whom that sent you to me. It would seem your instructor, Mathrengyl Bearwalker, has found a worthy pupil in you. I believe I see one as well. Heed his lessons and you shall soon be able to draw upon the Great Cat Spirit to take its shape.

Go back to whence you came. When the time is right, we will meet again.
The Oracle Tree
Find the Oracle Tree Bark nearby to receive its message.

I am impressed by what you have accomplished here in so short a time, $n. Would that I could ask you to remain here to assist me with my duties... but I know in my heart that greater tasks lie ahead for you.$b$bI have noticed the Oracle Tree has just shed a piece of its bark. No doubt it has a task that it wishes completed. You should speak with it.
As you inspect the fallen bark, a voice enters your mind. It is calm and soothing, cresting over you like a gentle breeze through the leaves.
Twisted Hatred
Kill $1oa Befouled Webwoods and bring Xethorr the Wicked's Mature Fel Moss to Tallonkai Swiftroot in Dolanaar.

Lord Melenas did not act alone; he was at the behest of another. The one you seek is Xethorr the Wicked. It seems he has twisted the spiders that call Teldrassil home, intending their venom for some foul plan.

He has taken residence deep in the forest, in the area to the northwest of here known as the Cleft. Take caution, and bring allies, for Xethorr is not an opponent to be trifled with.

Dispatch his brood, and bring me anything that may tell us more of the satyr's work here.

<Tallonkai lowers his voice.>

Does Xethorr still walk freely?

I should have known this was being used to twist the spiders of this land.

I have heard whispers of this substance being the source of much of the corruption plaguing us. Though this is not the original, it is an older sample and may yield more information than what we have obtained so far.

Normally I would have you send this to Darnassus for further study. However, it is best we kept this quiet for the moment, or Dolanaar will never recover its reputation.

I trust you to do the same.
The Great Windborne Cat Spirit
Recover the Relic of the Fang, Relic of the Claw, and Relic of the Silent Shadow from the Stormrage Barrow Den, and return them to the Avatar of Saeyleenan.

In order to draw upon my spirit, you will need to undergo a trial. To understand and respect my form you must prove that you can embody cunning, stealth, and if you should be cornered, ferocity.

In the Barrow Dens just east of here, are three relics you must acquire. They are guarded by powerful enraged spirits that will attack you on sight. A statue at the entrance will bless you with temporary stealth to get past them.

Return these relics to me to pass the druidic trial of these lands.
The Great Cat Spirit
Seek out the Great Cat Spirit in southern part Moonglade and learn what it has to share with you about the nature of the cat.

In the southern part of Moonglade, on a hill overlooking the bridge, resides a wise and cunning being we call the Great Cat Spirit.

Much like the Great Bear Spirit, this spirit has served as a tutor and mentor to druids that desire to take the feline shape. All druids eventually seek its wisdom, and if you desire to take the form of a cat, you will as well.

Go meet with the Great Cat Spirit and learn what it will teach you.
Show of Force
Collect $1oa Spiked Collars from Redridge Thrashers for Deputy Feldon near Lakeshire.

If the gnolls are growing so bold they are willing to camp this close to humans, there's no telling how much further they'll go. We need to deter them.

The beasts are hardly organized, but they seem to respect strength above all else. If we can slay the worst of them, maybe claim some of their trophies, we can remind these gnolls why they should stay in the hills where they belong.

Should you see any of their thrashers, bring me their collars. That should put the fear of the Alliance back into them.
A full assessment of the gnolls cannot be complete without facing the worst of their kind. Put those thrashers down!

Quite the armful you have.

While this doesn't solve our problem out here, I can rest comfortably knowing we've discouraged them pushing any further. Great work, $N.
Vengeful Trail
Maseara Autumnmoon wants you to search west of Forest Song, amongst the Satyrnaar demons. Report any signs of her husband Kurothel upon your return.

At the moment our fates bound us most vulnerable, tragedy fell upon our villages. Satyrs defiled our temples, their profane touch staining sacred boughs, and they slaughtered the innocent without mercy.

Kurothel was consumed by wrath. The druids are taking the fight to the satyr, and he has followed.

Our bond endures. I feel my husband, west, within these woods. Please, return to me with news of his fate.
Shared Fury

Kill $1oa Xavian Rogues, $2oa Felsworn, $3oa Betrayers, and $4oa Hellcallers.
Return to Maseara Autumnmoon in Forest Song afterwards.

Kurothel mentioned sightings of what they say are wolf-men. Those of the pack now lurking in greater numbers in our forest. Last we had spoken, druids were pursuing communication with those of the beast heart who displayed measured control of their animal instincts.

His written words show a darker struggle. If there is anything we can do to help see HIM again, surely quelling the demon threat that is driving him to this burning transformation will be of aid to his anguished soul.

Slay the Xavian, $n.
The Treaty of Understanding
Deliver the Treaty of Understanding to Magni Bronzebeard in Ironforge.

Inside of the vault you find a tablet detailing the terms of a peace treaty between the Bronzebeard and Wildhammer dwarf clans. It appears to date back to time period just after the War of the Three Hammers, and is very likely a notable piece of dwarven history. The king of Ironforge would no doubt be interested in this artifact.
What have you brought from the depths, $c.

Ah yes, my ancestor Madoran was the first Bronzebeard king of Ironforge following the great civil war between the Wildhammer, Bronzebeard, and Dark Iron clans. This treaty was drafted to codify the cessation of hostilities and terms of peace after the Bronzebeards won the mountain.

As you can see, the Wildhammers and Bronzebeards signed it... and the Dark Irons did not.

Thank you for recovering this and bringing it to me, $c.
Fizsprocket's Notes
Collect the rest of Supervisor Fizsprocket's pages inside The Venture Co. Mine and bring them to Morin Cloudstalker near Bloodhoof Village.

Some particularly worn papers are held separately, folded in Fizsprocket's inside breast pocket.

They seem to detail important information that could be used against the Venture Co. and its operations in the region. It would be prudent to look for more before returning to Morin Cloudstalker.
What is it you bring me, $c?

Ah, this is most valuable knowledge. I thank you for your efforts.

<Morin looks through the notes.>

It seems our next move is clear.
Ceasing Operations
Bring the Clearcutter Key to Morin Cloudstalker outside Bloodhoof Village.

The shredder one of the pages speaks of--I have seen them before in my travels. They can decimate a forest in a fraction of the time that hand and axe can.

Entire glades--homes to the Earth Mother's children for millennia--erased in days.

We will not allow this to happen in our home, a stone's throw from where our young ones take their first steps.

$n, I must ask you to gather others, go back into the mine to the northeast, and ensure it fells not a single tree more.
Has the shredder been stopped, $N?
All of Bloodhoof Village is in your debt this day. May the Earth Mother's grace stay with you always.
The Longwalkers
Help Perith Stormhoof escape Palemane Rock, and report his safety to Cairne Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff.

Hail, $c. What brings you deep into such a dark and violent place?

I was sent here by High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof as a part of our efforts to communicate with the gnolls that have taken residence. The rest of my mission must remain a secret, as do all things with the Longwalkers, the trusted scouts of our chieftain.

All you must know is our diplomacy was met with violence, and I fear I may be tonight's feast for the gnolls if you do not help me escape.

Are you up to the task?
Thunderhorn's Report
Bring Thunderhorn's Report to Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.

Our elders in Thunder Bluff must know of the progress we have made here, thanks to your aid.

Please, take this to Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem in Thunder Bluff. You will find him in the Elder Rise, on the east side of the city. You must take the lifts up to the center of the city, then cross the bridges to reach it.

Ah, no wonder there is such joy running through the streams of Mulgore. You have done a great service today. The wells provide much for not only our people, but to the wildlife we depend on for food, clothing, and companionship.

It is my humble pleasure to honor Mull's request. Please, accept this token of my gratitude.
The Valor Family
Find the cause of the Valor family ghosts in Raven Hill for Sirra Von'Indi in Darkshire.

Despite you putting down the Valor family ghosts, the reports of attacks have not ceased. It was a good gamble, but perhaps we did not settle their unfinished business after all.

From my research, it sounds like this family all went missing at the same time. Whatever trauma caused their spirits to be chained to this realm must have happened all at once.

Our only clue is where you found the book. Return to Raven Hill and see what you can find. Maybe bringing their weapons will spark something.
A Lack of Virtue
Deliver Tom's Gift to Bart Tidewater in Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands.

Bart Tidewater's a no-good cheapskate, I tell ya!

"Captain of the Maiden's Virtue" he calls himself. That ship's sailed as far as a rock in Tanaris! He's no captain, he's an actor who won enough hands of poker to buy the Virtue in the first place!

If you ever find yourself in Menethil Harbor over in the Wetlands, give this to him and let him know it's from ol' Half-fish.

There's a boat from here that can take you right to the harbor, by the way. It'll be the second stop!

And he cheats at poker!
Unrequited Love
Deliver Hollee's Note to Tarrel Rockweaver near Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands.

If you're heading out of Auberdine, I could use your help!

My dear friend Tarrel and I were classmates in school. Oh, he was such a quickfire on all things excavation! We got split up after graduation--him to Wetlands, and me to here in Darkshore.

<Hollee sighs, then her brow furrows slightly.>

Sorry, and his wife... Merrin.

It doesn't matter. If you go to the Wetlands, could you make sure he's alright? And maybe give him this? He's probably near Menethil Harbor. There's a boat straight there.
What's all this about?

<Tarrel reads the note.>

Oh... oh my. Poor Hollee.

She always did have a bit of a thing for me. And, truth be told, there was a time where I would have reciprocated. But I'm married. Happily married!

I think the best thing to do here is not to reply. I don't know how to let her down, and I have far more pressing things to worry about here! My wife is missing!
Talk of the Town
Visit Nixxrax Fillamug in the Salty Sailor Tavern in Booty Bay in Stranglethorn.

Look, I'm glad to have you at my bar, and that's exactly why I'm telling you this.

The real party? That's over at the Salty Sailor Tavern in Booty Bay. Yes, in Stranglethorn Vale--that Booty Bay.

Don't give me that look. I know it's run by goblins. Bartenders talk, and bar patrons talk a LOT. All I'm saying is that if you want to see things get real wild, head over there.

Nixxrax Fillamug will keep you topped up, don't even worry.
Al'Aketh Assassins
Kill 10 Al'Aketh Assassins in the Shen'dar Highlands.

You there, stranger. Get low and keep quiet. We are not alone here.

I was on patrol near the border and noticed that there are a number of Al'Aketh skulking around the house just up the hill there to the north. I don't know what they are doing here, but it can't be good.

If you want to make yourself useful, get in there and take them out. I'll wait here and watch your back.

I'm glad you made it back. That group of Al'Aketh looked like stone cold killers. 

Thank you for your aid, I'll include your assistance in my report when I return to Valanaar.
Call of Fire

Report to Sessaria Skystride or Aarnor Galestrike on Zephras Isle to continue your training as a Shaman. 

You can return to Zephras via the skycutter transport that docks in Mulgore at Skywatcher Plateau, northwest of Thunder Bluff.

Greetings, young Skyborne. The spirits have spoken of you, and tell me that you are ready to heed the call of fire. However, I shall not be the one to start you on that Path. Return to your home in the elemental plane, seek your mentors there. They will tell you what must be done.
Leonid's Letter
Deliver the Sealed Letter to Glix Xizzix in the Undercity.

Since you are here, I'd like you to deliver this letter to an old friend of mine in the Undercity. I'd deliver myself but I have a somewhat colorful history with the Dark Lady, and it would be better if a neutral third party made the delivery.

You are looking for a goblin named Glix Xizzix in the Trade Quarter area of the Undercity. I'm sure he'd be happy to compensate you for your time.

<Leonid lets out a low chuckle as he hands you the letter.>
What's that? You say that Leonid sent you? Oh boy, haven't seen that crusty old soldier since Naxxramas was raining hell down on our heads.

Thanks for delivering this, pal.

Wait... he said I'd tip you? I didn't agree to that! 

Fine. Take your pick of this junk in the lost and found. You'd be surprised how many of these Forsaken leave their stuff laying around after getting haircuts. There's a joke here about them being brainless, but I suspect in a lot of cases it might actually be true.
Hallowed Memorandum
Read the Hallowed Memorandum and speak to Branstock Khalder in Anvilmar.

While you were helping me out, this memorandum was given to me to pass on to you. Take some time to read it when you have a chance. I'm thinkin' it came from the priest trainer Branstock. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar when you've a chance.
Tainted Tablet
Read the Tainted Tablet and speak to Nartok inside the Den in the Valley of Trials.

Ah, while you were gone a tablet came for you, $n.$B$BI usually avoid dealing with warlocks if I can help it, but I think you should read it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from your newly-appointed trainer, Nartok. He would have words with you when you're ready.
Glyphic Parchment
Read the Glyphic Parchment and speak with Mai'ah near the entrance to the Den in the Valley of Trials.
Ah, while you were gone a parchment came for you, $n.$B$BRead it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from the mage trainer Mai'ah. She would have words with you when you're ready.

Ya come to Mai'ah ready to learn. Dat be good. Ya got da power to touch da strands of da cosmos, but ya also got da wisdom to know dat you need guidance. I can teach ya da first steps to wield dat power.

Da magic dat flows through you be da greatest power in da universe, but ya must be patient. Wait for da perfect moment to strike. Choose da right response to da problem at hand. If you be smart, and you watch carefully, dere be nothing you can't do.

When ya tink you be ready for trainin', come back to Mai'ah. She teach you what you ready to learn, no problem.
Archaic Rune
Read the Archaic Rune and speak to Teo Hammerstorm in Anvilmar.

While you were helping me out, this rune was given to me to pass on to you. Take some time to read it when you have a chance. Based on the Wildhammer style to these inscriptions, I'm guessin' this came from the shaman trainer Teo Hammerstorm. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar when you've a chance.
Ah, you were able to read the rune? It is imbued with the power of elements from some of our oldest script. That shows that you have the makings of a $c.

The shamanic arts have been kept by the Wildhammer clan for years, an' now those arts have passed into the care of the Bronzebeard dwarves as well. I'm here ta help spread these teachings an' offer guidance for new shamans learning the ways of the elements. Come ta me if ya need more trainin' in the spells of earth, air, fire, an' water.
A Difficult Path
Read the Consecrated Scroll and speak to Aramis Hammerhand in the church in Deathknell.

While you were off dealing with the mindless Scourge, this scroll arrived for you. It reeks of the light, so I imagine it's of some importance to a paladin like yourself.

Read it before heading out again. Just please--step away when you do. Paladins make me quite uneasy.
Through pain comes resolve.

Your training can now begin in earnest, $c. I see great promise in you, but take care not to turn away from the light, even for a moment. Embrace the pain it will cause you. That pain is a crucible, and you will emerge from it stronger than you ever were in your previous life.

Now that you have received my blessing, return to Dendrite. He will instruct you further. I do hope we meet again someday.
